# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 and platform support**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 advances to Skia m156 while improving GTK4 GPU rendering and platform support. The release restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies packages, adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with pixel scaling, and aligns native assets with .NET 11 previews.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Moves the bundled renderer to the Skia m156 engine and incorporates the current m155 fork cleanup. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies system fonts restored** — Linux packages without bundled dependencies can again discover system fonts through the installed font configuration. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **GTK4 gains native GPU rendering and pixel scaling** — GTK4 hosts can use native GPU rendering with scaling that matches the display pixel density. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **.NET 11 preview and WASM assets aligned** — Updates .NET 11 preview package pins and the WebAssembly native assets for the current SDK preview line. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))
- **Tizen 10 native builds updated** — Builds and packages native assets with the GCC 14.2 toolchain required for Tizen 10. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
